name: Are roof repair estimates free, or is there a charge?

mainEntity.name: Are roof repair estimates free, or is there a charge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many roofing companies, including Discounted Roofing Co., offer free initial roof repair estimates. This allows us to assess the damage and provide you with a detailed proposal without an upfront cost. However, some complex diagnostic estimates for issues that are not immediately apparent may incur a fee, which is typically disclosed upfront. We aim to provide transparent service to homeowners across our service areas, from Corsicana to Ennis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most initial roof repair estimates are free, including ours. Complex diagnostic estimates might have a fee, which is always disclosed upfront.
